author: gurvrx
text: Ivanti Connect Secure = ROOT in the wild. 3 chained zero-days, actively exploited by UTA0576: CVE-2026-104935 (unauth RCE 8.6), CVE-2026-111357 (priv-esc to root 8.8, CISA KEV), CVE-2026-118527 (file upload, deadline 11/13)

author: etugenio
text: A public Ivanti Connect Secure zero-day report had exactly one IOC. We crawled the operator's next proxy, a 9 GB open directory holding the full in-band root exploit chain, 168 run logs, and a Russian AI-agent memory file.

author: SockAnalystHQ
text: WordPress core CVE-2026-119977 (CVSS 8.1) is actively exploited. CISA added it to KEV Nov 3, federal deadline Nov 6. During a full core update, 4.7 to 7.1.3 stage the installer in a predictable public folder that attackers race for no-login RCE. Fix: 7.1.4 or a backport.

author: BleepinComputer
text: CISA flags WordPress RCE flaw as actively exploited in attacks (CVE-2026-119977)

author: techyoutbe
text: More than 1,000 exposed GitLab instances were reported unpatched against actively exploited CVE-2026-97229, a CVSS 10.0 RCE vulnerability fixed in versions 19.2.8, 19.3.5 and 19.4.2.

author: LifeboatHQ
text: CISA Adds Actively Exploited GitLab RCE (CVE-2026-97229) and Cisco Firewall DoS Flaws to KEV

author: pwnwatch_app
text: Critical, partly patched: Node-RED missing adminAuth actively exploited to drop bots and webshells (CVE-2026-58115). Exploited in the wild.

author: YourAnon_irc
text: New critical RCEs in PHP (PHP2Shell) & WordPress (CVE-2026-119977) are actively exploited. China-aligned DNS hijacking also observed.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Supply chain attack on cPGuard's update infrastructure pushed a credential-harvesting root shell script to ~2,950 Linux web hosting servers in a 70-minute window, with attacker access confirmed on some servers by hand.

author: AgentFieldKit
text: Strands Agents Tools before 0.8.6: per AWS (CVE-2026-115415), prompt injection could get the environment tool to return env vars unmasked, including API keys. Upgrade to 0.8.6 or remove the environment tool, then rotate keys.

author: Basant_Pandey
text: Docker Sandboxes CVE-2026-103916 (via Endor Labs): sbx cp followed symlinks, so a prompt-injected AI agent could reach host creds and SSH keys. Upgrade to 0.51.0.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Malicious versions of the Claude Code VS Code extension were distributed through Cursor's marketplace for 11 hours, exposing up to 5,000 developers to a supply chain attack carrying reconnaissance, persistence, and SSH backdoor capabilities.

author: rst_cloud
text: An operator used the pentestcode AI agent against 25 mid-size and large European companies and reports breaching 10 of them (31-10-2026).

author: vibelancer
text: GitBook got hit by an AI-agent breach on Nov 2. Rotate your API tokens, Git Sync secrets and MCP auth. GitBook says an attacker using AI agents reached its infrastructure credentials.

author: techie_piyush
text: LiteLLM, a Python library many AI teams use to call LLMs, was hit by a supply chain attack. Version 1.107.0 on PyPI and Docker shipped malware that steals environment variables and cloud credentials.

author: lemma_oracle
text: Supply-chain attack: a LiteLLM release built from an attacker's fork shipped with a genuine signature, live on PyPI for 1 h 44 min (~49,000 downloads).

author: Jiwai_
text: Binance incident report: theft of ~$6.34B. June 2026 supply-chain attack: a Wallet DevOps engineer downloaded a tampered Homebrew package via a search engine while installing a popular AI coding tool.

author: fanspark2
text: Binance attributes the $6.34B Oct 29 cyberattack on its platform to North Korea, citing FBI information.

author: The_Cyber_News
text: Hackers launch LLMjacking attacks, stealing access to corporate large language models and reselling it, leaving victims with cloud bills reaching $1 million (Mandiant).

author: TweetThreatNews
text: Google GTIG and Mandiant report LLMjacking incidents that drove cloud AI charges above $100,000 per day using exposed endpoints or stolen credentials and API keys.

author: techyoutbe
text: Meta paid $300,000 for one AI security vulnerability. Another researcher earned $90,000 for prompt injection. Total Muse bug bounties reached $1.2 million.

author: jackhidary
text: Isolated AI agents bypassed their virtual machines: in an OpenAI security experiment, two autonomous models in separate sandboxes communicated via shared hardware.

author: NedPeterson99
text: Glow Labs found AI coding agents pulling deprecated, never-to-be-patched Model Context Protocol reference MCP servers onto developer endpoints.

author: CryptoSignalUK
text: Mercado Bitcoin confirmed a security incident on 2 Nov ($38M breach).

author: OpenMatter_
text: A contractor reportedly ran a personal AI agent on a Pentagon network for two months, and a tampered Claude Code add-on spent 11 hours in Cursor's store.

author: OminouslyPie
text: Nikke CDN supply chain attack: well-documented gist on how it works and what to do.

author: SCMagazine
text: More than 1,000 GitLab servers remain exposed to an actively exploited, critical RCE flaw. Experts warn attackers could steal credentials and compromise software supply chains.

author: AgentFieldKit
text: Railway's preliminary report on the Oct 21 incident: up to about 100,000 workspaces (1.85%) may have had environment variables exposed. Railway says the attacker wanted AI and platform API keys. Rotate keys stored there, then redeploy.

author: RoundtableSpace
text: Binance has revealed how the $6.3B theft happened: a multi-stage campaign starting in June when a Wallet DevOps engineer searched for an AI coding tool and installed a tampered package.

author: TheExploitHQ
text: Stolen cloud keys can fuel six-figure daily bills. Mandiant details LLMjacking; Kaspersky tracks CyberStrikeAI; Chainlit and AWS MCP have path flaws. Rotate keys. Validate MCP paths.

author: f1tym1
text: JPCERT/CC has confirmed that a critical vulnerability in Airbyte is being actively exploited in the wild.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: Critical zero-click Android RCE patched (CVE-2026-58868): heap buffer overflow in Android's Framework component (FrameDecoder.cpp onOutputReceived) allows remote code execution with no additional privileges or user interaction.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: Critical SonicWall GMS vulnerability exposes internal files without authentication (CVE-2026-109593); SonicWall disclosed two flaws in Global Management System.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: Critical SolarWinds Dameware command injection flaw (CVE-2026-28336, CVSS 9.9) could allow attackers to compromise remote systems.

author: morphisec
text: Langflow critical RCE CVE-2026-105740 (CVSS 9.9) hit with 1,423 honeypot exploit attempts: any authenticated Langflow user can achieve RCE by registering an MCP server with stdio transport.

author: MrDanielKrol
text: Google GTIG: monthly vulnerability disclosures doubled, 5,045 in Jan to 10,477 in Jul 2026. Half of AI-found bugs lead to RCE, against 26% across all CVEs.

author: VALVETONLINE
text: PHP2Shell RCE (CVE-2026-109618) was found with AI help: an OOM crash filed as harmless in 2024 was turned into RCE in 2 weeks by an OpenAI-funded audit using AI; the patch took 4 engineers 2 months.

author: decvendra
text: GitBook says an AI-agent attack on Nov 2 reached its API tokens and git sync secrets, so every customer has to rotate keys and re-authenticate MCP. WorkOS and Chainstack disclosed similar breaches this week.

author: arnavsharma
text: GitBook says AI agents were used to reach some of its infrastructure credentials; visitor questions to its AI assistant are among data that may be exposed, next to API tokens and secrets. Rotate keys and re-auth MCP.

author: morphisec
text: Silent Lynx (UAT-6275) espionage campaign: WinRAR + PowerShell + PS2EXE chain drops custom reverse shells in CIS government networks.
